comment: Optional feature not supported: signed credential issuer metadata (signed_metadata). The issuer serves its metadata as plain application/json, so the suite skips this test.
Optional feature not supported: key attestations. The credential configuration takes the jwt proof type without key_attestations_required, so the suite skips this test.
Optional feature not supported: credential response encryption. The plan runs with vci_credential_encryption=plain, so the suite skips this test.
